dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge curvature following a parabolic spline from the posterior base to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute angle classification with a low pixel radius, resulting in a pointed morphological tip.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Convex anterior margin with a steep incline of approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Estimated ratio of 1.6:1 comparing the horizontal pixel base width to the vertical pixel height of the fin.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Broad convex curvature with a large radius extending from the dorsal apex of the head to the rostrum junction.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, blunt beak projection with a pixel length roughly equal to its vertical thickness at the base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle of approximately 145 degrees measured at the pixel coordinate where the melon meets the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform monochromatic cyan-teal color saturation across the entire visible surface; pronounced arched curvature of the caudal peduncle.
